accounts.from: CREATE2(account/<i>/salt, owner i), then its code and slots 0 and 1; the owner, any of the seed's first owners

given: PUBLIC: the contracts' addresses and the committee's public key

paths.label: m/44'/60'/0'/0/<i>
paths.purpose: owner i: the account's signer, and the EOA that deposits and buys tickets
paths.rebuilt_from: the account's address, from the CREATE2 salt below; its owner slot

paths.label: account/<i>/salt
paths.purpose: the CREATE2 salt of account i, deployed with owner i and an empty recovery commitment
paths.rebuilt_from: the address alone: code there means the account exists

paths.label: account/<i>/recovery-salt/<r>
paths.purpose: the salt of account i's r-th recovery commitment, keccak256(salt || 1 || recovery key's address)
paths.rebuilt_from: not needed to spend; hides the recovery key until a recovery reveals it

paths.label: pool/keychain
paths.purpose: kohaku-tornadocash-keychain's key: each privacy-pool note's secret and nullifier, by pool and nonce
paths.rebuilt_from: the pool's Deposit and Withdrawal events

paths.label: pool/recipient/<n>
paths.purpose: where the n-th withdrawal pays out

paths.label: custody/<vault>/<j>/nullifier
paths.purpose: the nullifier secret of the j-th registry note in a vault (custody per application)
paths.rebuilt_from: the registry's Inserted and Updated events, and scopeOf(vault)

paths.label: custody/<vault>/<j>/secret
paths.purpose: the secret of the same note

paths.label: view
paths.purpose: the viewing key: announcements sealed to it carry the openings of notes others made for the wallet

paths.label: ticket/<k>/sender
paths.purpose: the fresh sender the k-th ticket pays for
paths.rebuilt_from: its nonce: 0 means the ticket is unspent

paths.label: ticket/<k>/salt
paths.purpose: the k-th ticket's salt, in the message the committee signs

paths.label: ticket/<k>/blinding
paths.purpose: the k-th ticket's blinding factor r: the request is r * H(m)
paths.rebuilt_from: the committee's blinded answer, posted on the board beside r * H(m)

paths.label: ticket/<k>/binder
paths.purpose: the k-th ticket's one-time key: it signs the one transaction a bound ticket pays for (experiment 48)
paths.rebuilt_from: derived; its address is in the bound ticket's message

paths.label: backup/<v>/key
paths.purpose: the key of the v-th encrypted backup
paths.rebuilt_from: the backup itself, found by its locator

paths.label: backup/<v>/locator
paths.purpose: the tag the v-th backup is posted under

spends.what: the account, signed by its owner
